caption: The first row is the clockwise boundary code; the second row is its first difference; the third row is the shape number, the smallest rotation. Notice that the raw code starts with 0 0, but the normalised shape starts with 0 6.

spec.title: Chain code of a 3×3 ring
spec.aria: Three rows of eight digits: the chain code of the ring, its first difference, and the shape number obtained by rotating the difference once.
